note: Wooded hills and old fields south of Gallatin. One primitive camping spot, beside the gravel parking lot of the area's rifle and shotgun ranges, so expect gunfire in daylight. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Individual Campsites'; brochure 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map', 14 days; map (05/13) one Primitive Camping Area symbol beside the range lots = GIS 105. flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Camping: Individual Campsites'. Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map. Camping is limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period'; 'No open fires except in designated camping areas'. Map (05/13): the only Primitive Camping Area symbol is just east of the north range parking lot = GIS 105. Imagery: lot 1977 is a paved/gravel lot ~30 x 15 m on the gravel access road; a 23-ft rig fits. Designated point beside a lot (not a ramp lot): stays. No horse camp, ford or rig wording.

SHOOTING RANGE: the camp is beside the parking for the area's unstaffed rifle/pistol and shotgun ranges ('Shooting hours are one-half hour before sunrise to one-half hour after sunset'); the range safety zone lies just west of the lot. Noise only, noted in the note; criteria are AWH's call.
PIN: stored 39.84406,-93.91945 = GIS 105, on the east edge of the gravel access road ~40 m east of lot 1977. Nudge onto the lot: 39.84397,-93.91992.
CLUSTERS / NO SPLIT: one camping point; the other lots (1976 at the range firing line 130 m S, 1975 on Route M 1.6 km S) carry none.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): no water near the camp; the map's ponds are small and away from it.
Note rewritten: acreage, generic MDC text, the 14-day limit (now booking.max_stay_nights), 'site length not published' and directions dropped; the camp's place by the shooting ranges put in.
